recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中散布許多小型、深染的淋巴球而其他白血球很少，代表淋巴球增多；此倍率看不清腦回狀核，需高倍或流式細胞儀才能確認 Sézary 細胞。
features: Low-power field with increased number of small, round, dark-staining lymphoid cells
Cells roughly red-cell size with high N:C ratio
Nuclear contour detail (cerebriform folds) not resolvable at this magnification
Paucity of neutrophils in this field
Normocytic red cells and adequate platelets
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of small, uniform, dark-staining lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and few other leukocytes. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. The nuclear contours cannot be assessed at this magnification, so cerebriform morphology cannot be confirmed. The findings indicate a small-cell lymphocytosis compatible with Sézary syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting; high-power review and flow cytometry are required.

ddx.vs: CLL shows round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin, smudge cells and a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
T-PLL cells are slightly larger with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm and visible nucleoli rather than cerebriform nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with larger reactive forms and are polyclonal by flow cytometry and TCR studies.
